## QL DSL reference (CodeQL, javascript) — auto-generated by agent.dslgen.extract
## 25/34 constructs kept (26% reduction). See dialect_codeql_javascript.manual.txt for the hand-authored reference.

### Query shape
```
<query>            ::= <import> <config-decl> <flow-instantiation> <select-clause>

<import>           ::= "import javascript"

<config-decl>      ::= "module" <ConfigName> "implements" "DataFlow::ConfigSig" "{"
                          <isSource-pred>
                          <isSink-pred>
                          [ <isBarrier-pred> ]
                          [ <isAdditionalFlowStep-pred> ]
                        "}"

<isSource-pred>    ::= "predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {" <source-expr> "}"
<source-expr>      ::= <SourceClass> "= source"
                     |  "source instanceof" <SourceClass>
<SourceClass>      ::= "RemoteFlowSource" | "ThreatModelSource" | "Http::RequestInputAccess"
                     |  "CommandLineArguments" | "FileSystemReadAccess" | ...

<isSink-pred>      ::= "predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {" <sink-expr> "}"
<sink-expr>        ::= <sink-concept> "." <navigation>+ "= sink"
<sink-concept>     ::= "SystemCommandExecution" | "DatabaseAccess" | "SQL::SqlString"
                     |  "FileSystemWriteAccess" | "DomBasedXss::Sink" | ...
<navigation>       ::= "getACommandArgument()" | "getAQueryArgument()" | "getAPathArgument()"
                     |  "getArgument(" <int> ")" | "getAnArgument()"

<isBarrier-pred>   ::= "predicate isBarrier(DataFlow::Node node) {" <barrier-expr> "}"
<barrier-expr>     ::= <sanitizer-call> "= node"
                     |  "isBarrierGuard(" <guard-class> ")"

<isAdditionalFlowStep-pred>
                   ::= "predicate isAdditionalFlowStep(DataFlow::Node pred, DataFlow::Node succ) {" <step-expr> "}"

<flow-instantiation>
                   ::= "module" <FlowName> "=" <FlowKind> "<" <ConfigName> ">"
<FlowKind>         ::= "DataFlow::Global" | "TaintTracking::Global"

<select-clause>    ::= "from DataFlow::Node source, DataFlow::Node sink"
                        "where" <FlowName> "::flow(source, sink)"
                        "select sink, \"...flows from $@.\", source, source.toString()"
                     |  (* path-problem variant *)
                        "from" <FlowName> "::PathNode source," <FlowName> "::PathNode sink"
                        "where" <FlowName> "::flowPath(source, sink)"
                        "select sink.getNode(), source, sink, \"...\""
```

### Subset catalog

#### dataflow
- `signature module DataFlow::ConfigSig { predicate isSource(Node); predicate isSink(Node); ... }` — Module signature you implement to declare a data-flow configuration (sources, sinks, barriers, steps).
- `module MyFlow = TaintTracking::Global<MyConfig>` — Instantiates a taint-tracking global analysis (adds string/array/promise-manipulation steps) from a config module.
- `predicate flow(DataFlow::Node source, DataFlow::Node sink)` — Query predicate on the instantiated flow module: holds if source can reach sink.
- `predicate flowPath(PathNode source, PathNode sink)` — Path-aware variant of flow, needed for @kind path-problem queries that report the full path.
- `predicate isAdditionalFlowStep(DataFlow::Node pred, DataFlow::Node succ)` — Adds a custom value-preserving edge to the flow graph beyond built-in steps.
- `predicate isAdditionalTaintStep(DataFlow::Node pred, DataFlow::Node succ)` — Adds a custom taint-only (non-value-preserving) edge for a TaintTracking configuration.
- `predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink)` — Configuration predicate selecting which nodes count as taint/data sinks.
- `predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source)` — Configuration predicate selecting which nodes count as taint/data sources.

#### filter
- `predicate isBarrier(DataFlow::Node node)` — Blocks flow through a node entirely; used to encode sanitizers.
- `predicate isBarrierGuard(DataFlow::BarrierGuardNode guard)` — Registers a conditional (e.g. `if(x===...)`) as a flow-blocking guard on one branch.

#### other
- `class DatabaseAccess extends DataFlow::Node` — Sink concept: a database access; use getAQueryArgument() to reach the query-string sink.
- `class Sink extends Shared::Sink; class Source extends Shared::Source` — Pre-built source/sink classes for DOM XSS; reuse instead of writing a new config from scratch.
- `class FileSystemWriteAccess extends FileSystemAccess` — Sink concept for path-traversal/file-write vulns; getAPathArgument() gives the tainted path node.
- `class SqlString extends DataFlow::Node` — Sink concept: a string interpreted as a SQL command, used for SQL-injection sinks.
- `class SystemCommandExecution extends DataFlow::Node` — Sink concept: node executing an OS command; use getACommandArgument()/getArgumentList() to get the actual sink argument.

#### source
- `class ClientSideRemoteFlowSource extends RemoteFlowSource` — Browser-specific remote source (location, postMessage, window.name, etc.).
- `class RemoteFlowSource extends ThreatModelSource::Range` — Standard attacker-controlled input (HTTP params, env, etc.); typical taint-tracking source.

#### structural
- `class SourceNode extends DataFlow::Node instanceof SourceNode::Range` — Node from which local (intra-procedural) flow can be conveniently chased via helper predicates.
- `DataFlow::SourceNode moduleMember(string path, string m); globalVarRef(string name)` — Convenience entry points to reference an imported module member or global variable as a source node.
- `Expr asExpr(); AstNode getAstNode()` — Bridges a data-flow node back to its AST expression, e.g. for building alert messages/locations.
- `predicate flowsTo(DataFlow::Node sink)` — Holds if this source node reaches sink via zero-or-more local steps; core chaining primitive.
- `DataFlow::CallNode getACall(); getAMethodCall(string name); getAnInstantiation()` — Navigates from a source node to calls, method calls, or `new` invocations on it.
- `SourceNode getALocalSource()` — Gets the local origin of a node's value; inverse of flowsTo for backward navigation.
- `DataFlow::PropRead getAPropertyRead(string propName)` — Navigates from a source node to reads/writes of one of its properties.
- `DataFlow::Node getArgument(int i); getAnArgument()` — Gets a specific or any argument of an invocation node — common way to pin down a sink argument.
